senses.definition: a large area of water with land all around it
senses.example: We went swimming in the lake every summer morning.

senses.definition: to have enough money or time to buy or do something
senses.example: We can't afford a new car this year.

senses.definition: to be able to do something without causing problems for yourself
senses.example: You can't afford to miss any more classes before the exam.

senses.definition: to provide someone with something useful or pleasant
senses.example: The top floor affords a wonderful view of the sea.

senses.definition: knowing that something exists, is true or is happening
senses.example: Were you aware that the shop closes early today?

senses.definition: knowing a lot about a subject and caring about it
senses.example: Young people today are very environmentally aware.

senses.definition: an organization for specialist study, professional work or research, or its buildings
senses.example: She works at a research institute for marine biology.

relations.why: institution is a wider word for any large organization or long-established custom

senses.definition: to officially start or introduce a rule, system or legal action
senses.example: The company will institute a new policy on working from home.

senses.definition: the space inside a building entrance that leads to other rooms
senses.example: You can leave your wet boots in the hall.

senses.definition: a passage inside a building with rooms opening onto it
senses.example: Our classroom is at the far end of the hall.

senses.definition: a large room or building used for public events or shared activities
senses.example: Hundreds of people filled the concert hall last night.

senses.definition: a building where university or college students live
senses.example: Most first-year students live in halls near the campus.

senses.definition: a large house in the countryside
senses.example: They live in an old hall surrounded by fields.

grammar.note: often part of a house name

relations.why: sounds the same as haul, to pull something heavy
